key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: SUDDEN, abrupt start ("like a switch flipped"). LOCATION: Chest, palpitations. DURATION: Minutes to hours. CHARACTER: REGULAR, RAPID palpitations, "racing" heart. AGGRAVATING: Caffeine, stress, exertion. RELIEVING: Vagal maneuvers (bearing down, carotid massage), sometimes spontaneous. TIMING: Paroxysmal (sudden start and stop). SEVERITY: Uncomfortable but not painful typically. KEY POSITIVES: Heart rate 150-250 bpm, regular rhythm, lightheadedness, dyspnea, chest pressure, sudden onset and offset. KEY NEGATIVES: NOT irregularly irregular (AFib), NOT gradual onset.
